LCOM-GEN.description: Load Combination Auto Generation, General table (LCOM-GEN). Auto-generates load combinations into the General table (name prefix gLCB) for the selected DESIGN_TYPE (STEEL/CONCRETE/SRC) and its design code (DGNCODE); the request is a two-level flattened discriminated union where DESIGN_TYPE selects the code family and DGNCODE selects the per-code payload, so all fields are sent flat at one level.

SCALE_FACTOR_ITEM.description: Response-spectrum scale-up row. FACTOR must be in [0, 10].

LOAD_CASE.description: Response spectrum (RS) load case name; must resolve to an existing spectrum load case.

FACTOR.description: Scale factor applied to the spectrum load case; valid range [0, 10].

FACTOR_ITEM.description: Load case + scale factor row (over-strength factor). FACTOR must be > 0.

LOAD_CASE.description: Load case name; must resolve to an existing load case.

WIND_LOAD_CASE.description: Wind load cases per building type. BUILDING_TYPE=MIDDLE: ALONG required, TORSION forbidden, ACROSS optional. BUILDING_TYPE=HIGH: ALONG required, ACROSS/TORSION optional. ACROSS/TORSION may only name WA/WT load cases produced when Across/Torsional wind is enabled.

TORSION.description: Torsional-wind (WT) load case name (optional; forbidden when BUILDING_TYPE=MIDDLE).

BUILDING_TYPE.description: Wind loads group (case-insensitive). MIDDLE = mid-rise, HIGH = high-rise (dynamic wind, needs GUST_FACTOR/KAPPA_FACTOR).

GUST_FACTOR.description: [BUILDING_TYPE=HIGH] Gust factor GD; required only for high-rise dynamic wind, unused for MIDDLE.

KAPPA_FACTOR.description: [BUILDING_TYPE=HIGH] Kappa factor; required only for high-rise dynamic wind, unused for MIDDLE.

WIND_LOAD_COMB.description: Wind load combination set. Optional field on the leaf: absent or empty PARAMETERS leaves the wind record untouched (no-op).

PARAMETERS.description: List of wind load combination sets.

ORTHO_EFFECT.description: Orthogonal effect. When OPT_USE=true, TYPE and LOAD_GROUP are required (LOAD_GROUP must have exactly 2 distinct load cases of the same type). When OPT_USE=false they are forbidden.

TYPE.description: [OPT_USE=true] Orthogonal effect type (case-insensitive): 100_30 = 100:30 combination, SRSS = square-root-sum-of-squares.

LOAD_GROUP.description: [OPT_USE=true] Exactly two distinct load case names (Load Case1, Load Case2) of the same load-case type (no ST/RS mixing).

ADDITIONAL_SPECIAL_LOAD.description: Special seismic load. When OPT_USE=true, VERTICAL_LOAD_FACTOR (> 0), SDS and OVER_STRENGTH_FACTOR are required; when OPT_USE=false they are forbidden.

VERTICAL_LOAD_FACTOR.description: [OPT_USE=true] Vertical load factor; must be > 0 (CheckSlcf strict).

ADDITIONAL_VERTICAL_LOAD.description: Vertical seismic load. When OPT_USE=true, FORCE_FACTOR (> 0) is required; when OPT_USE=false it is forbidden.

FORCE_FACTOR.description: [OPT_USE=true] Vertical force factor; must be > 0 (CheckSlcf strict).

ADDITIONAL_LOAD.description: Additional load. Either half may be omitted; an omitted half behaves as OPT_USE=false. If neither half is used, any existing additional-load (T_SLCF) record is cleared.

DIRECTION.description: Seismic load case direction (case-insensitive): POSITIVE (UG+) or NEGATIVE (UG-).

LOAD_CASE_SEISMIC.description: Earth-pressure seismic load case names; each must resolve to an STLD of LoadCaseType EEP.

LOAD_CASE_STATIC.description: Earth-pressure static load case names; each must resolve to an STLD of LoadCaseType EH.

UNDERGROUND_SPECIAL_LOAD.description: Underground special load. When OPT_USE=true, VERTICAL_LOAD_FACTOR (> 0), SDS and OVER_STRENGTH_FACTOR are required; when OPT_USE=false they are forbidden.

OPT_USE.description: Use special load for underground load.

OVER_STRENGTH_FACTOR.description: [OPT_USE=true] Over-strength factors for underground special load.

UNDERGROUND_LOAD.description: Underground load. Optional field on the leaf: absent behaves as OPT_USE=false (dialog-unchecked, overwrites with empty record). When OPT_USE=true, SCALE_FACTOR and LOAD_CASE_LIST (>= 1 entry) are required; SPECIAL_LOAD is optional.

SCALE_FACTOR.description: [OPT_USE=true] Underground scale factors; each FACTOR in [0, 10] and LOAD_CASE must resolve.

LOAD_CASE_LIST.description: [OPT_USE=true] Underground load case list; must contain at least one entry.

Argument.description: Flattened auto-generation request. DESIGN_TYPE selects the code family and DGNCODE selects the per-code payload; all leaf inputs are sent at this same flat level.

DESIGN_TYPE.description: Design type / code family (case-insensitive). Selects which DGNCODE values are valid and which combinations are generated (all output lands in the General table).

OPTION.description: Add or replace existing combinations (case-insensitive). ADD = append (mode 0); REPLACE = wipe this design type's combinations then regenerate (mode 1). Applies to every code path including AIK-SRC2K.

ADD_ENVELOPE.description: Add envelope option (General-only dialog checkbox, default-checked). When true, envelope rows are added to the generated General combinations.

DGNCODE.description: Design code (case-insensitive), must match DESIGN_TYPE: STEEL -> "KDS 41 30 : 2022"; CONCRETE -> "KDS 41 20 : 2022"; SRC -> "KDS 41 SRC : 2022" or "AIK-SRC2K". AIK-SRC2K takes a minimal path (only RS_SCALE_FACTOR is consumed; every other optional feature stays off).

RS_SCALE_FACTOR.description: Response Spectrum scale-up rows (optional; absent = no scale-up). Available for all design types/codes.

WIND_LOAD_COMB.description: [DESIGN_TYPE=STEEL/CONCRETE/SRC with KDS code; not AIK-SRC2K] Wind load combination set (optional; absent/empty = no-op).

ORTHO_EFFECT.description: [DESIGN_TYPE=STEEL/CONCRETE/SRC with KDS code; not AIK-SRC2K] Orthogonal effect (optional; absent = OPT_USE false).

ADDITIONAL_LOAD.description: [DESIGN_TYPE=STEEL/CONCRETE/SRC with KDS code; not AIK-SRC2K] Additional (special/vertical seismic) load (optional; absent = disabled).

UNDERGROUND_LOAD.description: [DESIGN_TYPE=STEEL/CONCRETE/SRC with KDS code; not AIK-SRC2K] Underground load (optional; absent = OPT_USE false / overwritten empty).
